notes: Phase 1 ships the machinery and ONE registered pair of mechanical types (obligation_due / obligation_grace_expiry). Phase 2 extended the bridge additively with `futureHookPrefixes` (src/sim/contracts/scheduledEvents/registry.ts findScheduledEventDefinitionForHookName): Phase 1 matched a hook name against the event-type key exactly, which cannot claim the parameterised families that are the majority of the HOOK-* rows.
